query: On the other side of the cross-feeding interaction, the alanine-consuming subpopulation in the aerobic mid-height region of the colony strongly benefits from the secreted alanine originating from the base of the colony. Due to Fick's law of diffusion, a steeper concentration gradient causes a higher diffusive flux.
